visual_action: The video shows clips from a formal ceremony at what appears to be the White House. It begins with a shot of an audience applauding, focusing on soccer player Megan Rapinoe. It then cuts to a close-up of President Joe Biden speaking. The final shots show Biden placing the Presidential Medal of Freedom around Rapinoe's neck. She then shakes his hand and they embrace.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is shown speaking and awarding the medal.

cast.name: Megan Rapinoe
cast.evidence: Joe Biden names her while presenting her with the Presidential Medal of Freedom. She is also shown prominently throughout the video.

cast.name: Khizr Khan
cast.evidence: He is visible in the background behind Megan Rapinoe and Joe Biden, also wearing a Presidential Medal of Freedom.

cast.name: unnamed man with mustache
cast.evidence: An unidentified man with a mustache is shown sitting next to Megan Rapinoe in the audience at the start of the video.

spoken_summary: President Joe Biden speaks about Megan Rapinoe, stating, "Megan is one of the most accomplished soccer players and the first soccer player to receive the Medal of Freedom." The rest of the audio is applause from the audience.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of diegetic sound from the event: President Biden's speech and applause from the audience. There is no background music.
editing_pacing: The video uses simple cuts between different shots of the ceremony. The pacing is slow and documentary-style.
central_claim: President Joe Biden awarded celebrated soccer player Megan Rapinoe the Presidential Medal of Freedom.
intended_effect: To create positive sentiment for the Biden administration by highlighting its recognition of a prominent and accomplished athlete.
